items.source: This converter supports by default "application/x-protobuf", "application/*+x-protobuf" and "text/plain" with the official "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java" library. The "application/json" format is also supported with the "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util" dependency. See ProtobufJsonFormatHttpMessageConverter for a configurable variant.
items.translation: 此转换器默认支持使用官方 `"com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java"` 库的 `"application/x-protobuf"`、`"application/*+x-protobuf"` 和 `"text/plain"`。此外，通过 `"com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util"` 依赖项也支持 `"application/json"` 格式。有关可配置的变体，请参阅 ProtobufJsonFormatHttpMessageConverter。
